security.csp: default-src 'self' ipc: http://ipc.localhost; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data:; font-src 'self' data:; connect-src ipc: http://ipc.localhost

bundle.longDescription: A real terminal (zsh, bash or PowerShell) dressed in an Escape from Tarkov-inspired interface: tabs, a tactical status bar and raid-end screens when a shell exits. Fan-made, not affiliated with Battlestate Games.
